title: Synthesis — opportunity map
purpose: Quotes are not insight. Affinity-map frictions, size them with Phase 1 + micro-surveys, segment the mix, score RICE-like. Ranked backlog, not a quote dump.
north_star: Wishlist / consideration → purchase conversion on Myntra
output: Segmented opportunity map: friction type × Reach × Frequency × Conversion lift × Confidence ÷ Effort, cut by category / tenure / wishlist size.
status_note: Empty until Phase 1 warehouse rates and Phase 2 fieldwork (affinity + micro-surveys) exist. Public VOC opportunity_score is a different ranking — do not paste it here. Do not invent percentages.

formula_notes.Reach: % of non-converted wishlist volume this friction plausibly explains (Phase 1 denominator + survey share). Not unique attribution.
formula_notes.Frequency: How often it shows up among those items (micro-survey share or incidence). 1–5 if units differ.
formula_notes.Conversion_lift: Potential relative lift if addressed. Product judgment, triangulated — not a fake A/B.
formula_notes.Confidence: Quant + qual + survey triangulation. Low if only 15–20 interviews.

sizing_format_example: ~35% of removed items cite 'found cheaper elsewhere,' concentrated in footwear and elect-adjacent accessories. FORMAT ONLY — not a measured number.

steps.title: Affinity-map into friction types
steps.job: Cluster every diary line, live-wishlist note, and survey 'other' into a discrete friction type. Quotes are evidence for a type, not the deliverable.

steps.title: Quantify (directional attribution)
steps.job: What % of non-converted wishlist items does each friction plausibly explain? Phase 1 volumes + micro-survey shares. Write the concentration (category / price), not a national average only.

steps.title: Segment the map
steps.job: Mix differs by category, tenure, wishlist size. Rank inside cells. Heavy-wishlist conversion may be the wrong metric (bookmarking).

steps.title: RICE-like score
steps.job: Reach × Frequency × Conversion lift × Confidence ÷ Effort. Rank by score, not by how vivid the quote was.

friction_types.label: Fit doubt
friction_types.signal: Size/fit risk; not sure it will look like the photo

friction_types.label: Price-wait
friction_types.signal: Waiting for a sale; found cheaper elsewhere

friction_types.label: Occasion timing
friction_types.signal: No event yet; saved for a known future occasion

friction_types.label: Social validation
friction_types.signal: Friend / haul / who else bought this

friction_types.label: Forgetting
friction_types.signal: Zero revisits; item aged out of mind

friction_types.label: Style regret
friction_types.signal: Changed mind on look; no longer needed

segment_hypotheses.hypothesis: Occasion-wear → social validation + timing. Basics → price + forgetting. Footwear → fit risk.
New users → trust gap. Repeat buyers → price-timing habit.
Light wishlisters → genuine intent. Heavy wishlisters → bookmarking; improving conversion there may be the wrong metric.
